name: Gautam Exim Limited
about: Gautam Exim Limited engages in the import and trading of waste paper, pulp, specialty chemicals, and finished paper in India. It exports kraft paper rolls and pulps, fluting media and liner boards, writing and printing papers, news prints, and paper boards for tubes and cones; and imports recyclable paper fibre and pulp, and industrial specialty chemicals. The company also provides import trading; import aggregation and import facilitation services of industrial raw material, stores, spares, etc. to paper mills, chemical units, and other manufacturing units. It serves paper mills, chemical manufacturing units, and steel mills. Gautam Exim Limited was founded in 1997 and is based in Vapi, India.
